newsitem.title: USA: Brunswick Corp completes Roadmaster buy.
newsitem.headline: Brunswick Corp completes Roadmaster buy.

text.p: Brunswick Corp said Friday it completed the purchase of essentially all of the assets of Roadmaster Industries Inc's Roadmaster bicycle business and Flexible Flyer line of sleds and wagons for $198 million cash.
The purchase price was $14 million less than the price planned when the deal was first announced, due to a decline in working capital in the Roadmaster assets, a Brunswick spokesman said.

"Roadmaster bicycles command the number two domestic market share position, and our intent is to become the market leader," Brunswick chief executive Peter Larson said in a news release. "This unit will benefit from many synergies it shares with our growing line of outdoor recreational products."
